verdict.rationale: Grafana's provisioning-as-code, CLI, and OpenAPI API (grafana-docs-2/3/16/26, grafana-probe-3/5) enable scripted, multi-item changes to dashboards/data sources, and alerting can span many data sources at once (grafana-docs-1/25). However, there is no explicit documentation or example of true bulk operations (e.g., batch-editing or bulk-deleting many dashboards/alerts/users in one action) — the evidence only shows individual config-as-code and CLI primitives that could be scripted for bulk use, not a dedicated bulk-operation feature. Missing for 10: explicit bulk-edit/bulk-delete API or UI documentation, and independent confirmation that these primitives are actually used for bulk automation.
